title: Reach the Hadal Trench
briefing: The campaign's deepest boundary lies in the Hadal Trenches. Survive the pressure, find the wraith that hunts the trench floor, and end it.
fieldGuide: Late-campaign combat milestone for the Deep Reach route.

objectives.label: Enter the Hadal Trenches
objectives.detail: Descend into the deepest recorded biome of the Deep Reach.

objectives.label: Kill a Hadal Wraith
objectives.detail: Put down the apex predator that claims the trench floor.

rewards.label: Abyssal Stone
rewards.detail: Pressure-forged stone for the deepest outposts.

rewards.label: Vent Crab Shell
rewards.detail: Salvaged plating useful for reinforcing dive gear.

completionText: The Hadal Trench is no longer just a depth reading. You have walked the floor and survived its wraith.
